dateline: Seoul / Global — Rest day post-Mexico City; HYBE × Geffen reveals SAINT SATINE; Stanford Stadium debut approaching May 16–19
heroHeadline: Day 4,716: SAINT SATINE Revealed; BTS Rests Before Stanford Stadium Debut (May 16–19)
heroSubtitle: May 12, 2026 is Day 4,716 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS is on a rest and travel day following the completion of their record-breaking three-night Mexico City run at Estadio GNP Seguros (May 7, 9, 10) — approximately 150,000 total fans and an estimated $107.5 million in economic impact, the largest K-pop economic footprint on any Latin American city in history. The group's next shows are three sold-out dates at Stanford Stadium in Stanford, California (May 16, 17, and 19), making BTS only the second musical act ever to perform at the venue after Coldplay. After Stanford, the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas for four nights (May 23, 24, 27, 28) alongside the 'BTS: The City Arirang' citywide festival (May 20–31). In the broader HYBE ecosystem, May 12 marks the reveal of SAINT SATINE — HYBE × Geffen Records's new global girl group, unveiled at the 'World Scout: The Final Piece' finale on ABEMA with four members (Emily, Lexie, Samara, Sakura) and two debut tracks. Additionally, Billboard named three HYBE executives to its 2026 Indie Power Players list: Han Sung-soo, So Sung-jin, and Shin Seon-jeong.
